name: yuzu2epub
description: Chrome extension that turns a purchased Yuzu textbook into a single Kindle-ready EPUB. The extension itself needs no build step; these dev dependencies exist only to run the tests.

scripts.test: node test/context-apis.test.mjs && node test/toc.test.mjs && node test/storage.test.mjs && node test/extract.test.mjs && node test/pipeline.test.mjs && node test/navmap.test.mjs && node test/scale.test.mjs && node test/build-fixture.mjs && python3 test/validate_epub.py test/fixture.epub && python3 test/validate_epub.py test/pipeline.epub && python3 test/validate_epub.py test/scale.epub && python3 test/validate_epub.py test/navmap.epub
scripts.check: for f in extension/*.js extension/lib/*.js extension/injected/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'syntax ok'
